scenarios.title: Chennai to Delhi (Grand Trunk Express Connection Collapse)
scenarios.description: Passenger departs Chennai Central on Grand Trunk Exp (12615) connecting at Nagpur for Telangana Exp (12723) to Delhi. A 30-min delay leaves only 15 min at Nagpur, causing a missed connection.

replanned_options.name: Multimodal Rail+Air Bypass via Nagpur Airport
replanned_options.reasoning: Even with 30m train delay, passenger arrives Nagpur by 12:00. IndiGo 6E-671 departs at 14:40 (160 min buffer), reaching Delhi at 16:25—saving 915 minutes vs waiting for next day's train.

replanned_options.name: Alternative Rail Via Vijayawada & Vande Bharat Connect
replanned_options.reasoning: Morning departure via Vande Bharat with solid 180 min connection window at Vijayawada, avoiding congested central corridor delay hotspots.

replanned_options.name: Direct Flight Rebook (IndiGo 6E-2041)
replanned_options.reasoning: Emergency direct option for time-critical travel, bypassing entire ground track disruption.
